summary.name: AI Room Planner
summary.one_liner: A web tool that takes a photo of a room and generates AI redesign previews in a chosen interior style and room type.
use_cases: Previewing a room makeover before committing to renovation
Generating mood board and design inspiration for a room
Creating virtual staging images for property listings
Producing visual briefs to share with a contractor or designer
Testing color schemes and furniture layouts in a photo
summary.what_it_does: The tool lets you upload a photo of a room, pick one of 60+ design themes and a room type (the page cites 30+ to 40+ room types across sources), and receive an AI-generated redesign, reported to render in roughly 10 to 30 seconds. The page says it analyzes room proportions, windows and existing furniture and tries to preserve walls, openings and natural light so results stay plausible. Named styles include Scandinavian, Japandi wabi-sabi, French country and modern industrial. Output is described as high-resolution, with 4K renders available through paid credit packs.
notable: Upload a room photo and get an AI redesign in seconds across 60+ styles
Preserves walls, windows and structural openings according to the page
Free preview credits with no credit card or sign-up required
Pay-as-you-go credit packs for higher-resolution or 4K renders
caveats: Free use is limited to preview credits; 4K renders and extensive exploration require paid pay-as-you-go credit packs
Results are AI interpretations, not exact replicas of the real space
Render time is stated to depend on server load
